summary: Install lifecycle references a missing script
details: package.json declares scripts.install as 'echo "hey hey hey hoooo" &&./install.sh', but install.sh is not shipped in the tarball (files whitelist contains only index.js, cli.js, and README.md). On npm install the hook will echo the string and then fail when attempting to execute the missing script. No remote fetch, no credential access, no network callback, and no attacker-controlled bytes are introduced by the install hook; it is broken rather than harmful.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
